explanation:
Read-only audit of pristine18.7, fully patched18.7, and pristine18.10 found one current-baseline diagnostic defect introduced by 0074 and one new upstream retry-safety regression; no tests, builds, provider calls, live credentials, or file modifications were performed, and all three required policy grep checks passed.

Owned-family dispositions — 0074-anthropic-context-cache-boundaries: REBASE, not retire; preserve final-fetch diagnostics and the patched eligibility policy for byte-stable extension context, porting that policy into upstream's backward checkpoint walk at pristine18.10/pi-ai/src/providers/anthropic.ts:4496-4584 rather than replacing the optimized walk wholesale; repair the native-compaction classification finding below; preserve cacheRetention=none on OAuth, because stock buildAnthropicSystemBlocks at 4037-4044 still creates an identity breakpoint when getCacheControl at 726-744 returns undefined for none, whereas patched18.7 removes that default decoration at 3635-3642; acceptance: serialized OAuth/API-key/custom-gateway requests with stable tools/system, per-call-marked stable messages, clear_at messages, and none/short/long retention must have the intended eligible boundaries and no more than four breakpoints, with native compaction classified separately and its baseline comparison actually executed; reject the apparent ordinary-OAuth three-head-breakpoint defect, because applyHeadCaching at pristine18.10:4646-4682 already moves the identity breakpoint to the stable-system anchor, and pristine18.7 has the same compensating relocation at 4082-4119; the fifteen-user-turn checkpoint interval is not a proof of Anthropic's content-block lookback coverage when turns contain many tool/image blocks, nor is local prefix equality proof of a provider hit — 0094-anthropic-thinking-drop-resume: BLOCK mechanical replay, then REBASE with split semantics; patched18.7 restores validated endpoint/model/provider-scoped stable signature/redacted-data keys at anthropic.ts:534-569 and 2165 and persists them at 1987-1992, while stock18.10 has no droppedThinkingReplay reader or writer; upstream deliberately changed applyReportedInputTransformations at 2240-2289 to keep server-reported drop_block blocks on the wire and only deduplicate warnings, so restoring the old unconditional learning behavior would undo an intentional upstream cache-prefix policy rather than fix a regression; retain restoration of existing durable records for the first post-upgrade request and durable recording of client-side removals caused by the explicit prefix-binding-400 path at stock18.10:3651-3682, but do not automatically turn new server-side drop_block reports into client-side removals; acceptance: a fresh state map reproduces previously persisted local omissions, foreign endpoint/model/provider and malformed records drop nothing, new server-managed drops remain byte-identical on subsequent calls, and explicit 400 fallback omissions survive a second fresh process — 0092-cache-warming-idle-budget: REBASE, not retire; stock cache-warmer.ts is byte-identical between pristine18.7 and pristine18.10, retains the fixed thirty-minute idle horizon at lines 61 and 412-419, and discards the request at settlement rather than parking it, so it does not replace the local environment-owned horizon, expiry-anchored parking, or result event; preserve patched18.7 cache-warmer.ts:442-572 and 630-676 plus SDK report wiring, shared event types, and declarations; the result event reaches the actual generic handler registry in extension runner.ts:1583-1618 rather than being silently dropped; SDK arming excludes one-shot fallback-credit redemption at stock18.10/sdk.ts:4370-4388, and patched host agent-session.ts:5160-5200 invalidates warming on transcript identity or model/system/tools/thinking/retention shape changes; acceptance: raising the horizon after settlement resumes only before the original cache expiry, miss/error stops warming, result handlers receive usage and stop reason, and navigation/disposal cancels retained work.

Transport/state conclusions and proposed parent probes — actual request bytes are JSON.stringify(params) at pristine18.10/pi-ai/src/providers/anthropic-client.ts:266, sent through fetch at 321-329, with the OAuth CCH fetch wrapper rewriting attestation at anthropic.ts:889-903; capture there, not at onPayload, and keep attestation normalization distinct from server cache evidence; native compaction preserves the common request builder but stripCompactionIncompatibleParams at 4313-4328 removes context_management, stop sequences, forced tool choice, output format, and remaining task budget, so compare the intended shared prefix separately from those legitimate envelope differences; catalog between-tools-effort is declared in axes.ts:234 and consumed in anthropic.ts:5304-5306 and 5350-5354, including Factory Droid's high-effort policy at pi-catalog/src/compat/rules/providers/factory-droid.kdl:1145-1147; disabled-thinking history stripping, effort-control constraints, foreign-signature/redacted-thinking safeguards, and tool-result normalization were traced through their consumers, with no additional proven regression reported; endpoint/model runtime cache fallback is latched only after a successful turn at anthropic.ts:3964-3974, opaque injected clients are isolated by client identity and session anchor at 594-699, and these runtime latches remain cold-process learned state rather than durable restoration; propose only three focused synthetic probes in the parent's private runtimes: (1) actual final-fetch capture combining ordinary/native-compaction requests, OAuth/API-key retention choices, four-breakpoint accounting, stable per-call messages and a simulated cache-control rejection ladder, asserting audit classification and serialized headers/body rather than cache hits; (2) a replay fixture combining persisted signed/redacted invalidation records, fresh state maps, new server-reported drops, explicit prefix-binding rejection, and a fallback-credit handle containing an already-executed server tool, asserting that cache-rejection recovery never sends an uncredited ordinary replay after that tool; (3) a controlled-clock actual CacheWarmer/extension-runner probe covering parked long-TTL resume, original-expiry rejection, miss/error reporting, and context cancellation.

findings.title: Recognize the current native-compaction envelope in the wire audit
findings.body: CURRENT-BASELINE / 0074: A native compaction request produced by patched18.7 anthropic.ts:5009-5013 carries top-level `compaction: { type: "summarize" }`, but this new audit recognizes only the legacy `context_management.edits[].pause_after_compaction` envelope. Consequently the native request is labeled main/side/compaction-replay and never enters the `if (compact)` comparison at lines 97-113; when neither sideRequest nor refresh is set, it also replaces the ordinary baseline at lines 115-118. This prevents the retained diagnostic from detecting native-compaction prefix drift on the current baseline, independently of any server behavior. Recognize the top-level summarize envelope as native compaction while retaining the legacy detector, and keep both out of ordinary baseline advancement.

findings.title: Use the credit-aware rebuild path for cache-control retries
findings.body: TARGET-UPSTREAM regression: Both new cache-control fallback rungs call `prepareParams()` directly, unlike the existing strict-tools, thinking, and fast-mode fallbacks that call `rebuildParams(streamFailure)`. If a live fallback-credit redemption is rejected for cache_control after reaching the unchanged-body rung, this constructs an ordinary request without the credit token while leaving `usingFallbackCredit` true and bypassing `forfeitFallbackCredit` at lines 2831-2845. A redemption whose refusedContent already contains an anthropicServerTool can therefore replay and rebill that work instead of surfacing the failure; the retry also retains the redemption header branch at lines 2924-2934 despite no longer sending the frozen redemption body. The path is reachable through SDK redemption forwarding at pi-coding-agent/src/sdk.ts:4370-4380. Use the existing credit-aware rebuild helper in both new rungs, so server-tool redemptions fail closed and permissible tokenless retries clear redemption state.
